as_told.title: Analysts found odd heavy-element atomic arrangements in recovered material

plain: People who analysed material from 'the real deal', meaning genuine recovered UFO material, found it super weird, full of heavy elements like europium and californium. David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned whistleblower, says this on Michels' show, passing on what those analysts told him. He says it in two episodes, naming the elements only in the second.
